panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (A, B, C, D). The knees had small and irregular femoral and tibial epiphyses and irregular metaphyses. The pelvis showed some flattening of the proximal femoral epiphyses but they were relatively spared. There was some irregularity of the vertebral end plates (arrow).
